[SWS_ComM_00794]
Upstream requirements: SRS_ModeMgm_09083
⌈De-initialization in ComM_DeInit() shall only be performed if all channels controlled
by the ComM module are in COMM_NO_COMMUNICATION mode.⌋
Rationale for [SWS_ComM_00794]: Since the ComM_DeInit()API cannot return an
error message, it must be assured that all channels are in COMM_NO_COMMUNICATION
mode and COMM_NO_COM_NO_PENDING_REQUEST sub-state before ComM_DeInit()is
called.
